content.user_title: Build a Daily Science Fiction Routine
content.value_statement: Science-fiction roleplay can lose focus when daily research scenes lack structure. This skill provides a staged routine for observations, experiments, logs, and discoveries.
actual_capabilities: Guides a five-stage research routine from station setup through a breakthrough.
Supplies scene beats for sample collection, analysis, logging, and reflection.
Provides fictional research-log details and scientific observation prompts.
Maintains Stella Chen as a calm, methodical scientist character.
Offers ending branches for breakthrough, peaceful routine, and collaborative science.
limitations: The skill is a writing guide, not a real laboratory protocol.
Its scientific discoveries are fictional and should not be treated as factual research.
The source material is mainly Chinese with some English phrases.
It focuses on one character and a Gaia survival-fiction setting.

use_cases.title: Write a focused research scene
use_cases.description: Create a calm scene where Stella gathers samples, records observations, and forms a testable hypothesis.

use_cases.title: Plan a roleplay session
use_cases.description: Run a 25 to 30 minute narrative session with structured scientific activities and a clear emotional arc.

use_cases.title: Develop an alien ecosystem
use_cases.description: Add plant behavior, environmental signals, and research questions that support worldbuilding.

prompt_templates.title: Start a research station
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Daily Science Routine to write Stella establishing a small research station after survival becomes stable. Keep the tone calm and practical.

prompt_templates.title: Collect morning samples
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a morning sample-collection scene for Stella. Include three alien plant observations, careful documentation, and one unanswered question.

prompt_templates.title: Develop a hypothesis
prompt_templates.prompt: Write an afternoon analysis scene where Stella compares samples and develops a cautious hypothesis. Include observations, uncertainty, and a safe fictional test.

prompt_templates.title: Complete a research arc
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a five-stage Daily Science Routine session that ends with plants responding to light signals. Preserve scientific curiosity and avoid claiming the result is proven.

output_examples.input: Write a morning collection scene for a new alien flower.
output: Stella labels the flower as Sample 004 and records its location, light level, and petal structure.
She notes that each petal reflects a different color and plans to observe nearby creatures before drawing conclusions.

output_examples.input: Create an evening research log after a productive day.
output: Gaia Research Log, Day 6: Three new flora samples classified and one pollination hypothesis recorded.
Tomorrow: observe the flower at dusk and compare its light response with nearby moss.

output_examples.input: Give the session a peaceful ending.
output_examples.output: Stella reviews the notes on her data wall and finds satisfaction in careful progress rather than a dramatic result.

best_practices: Treat discoveries as hypotheses until the character gathers supporting observations.
Use specific notes, measurements, and questions to make scenes feel grounded.
Balance technical details with Stella’s emotional response and personal history.
anti_patterns: Do not present fictional biology as real scientific guidance.
Do not make every observation an immediate, world-changing discovery.
Do not replace methodical investigation with unexplained conclusions.

faq.question: What does this skill help me write?
faq.answer: It helps you write a daily scientific research routine for an interactive science-fiction scenario.

faq.question: Is this a real science or laboratory skill?
faq.answer: No. It is a fictional writing guide and does not provide real experimental procedures.

faq.question: Who is the main character?
faq.answer: The guide centers on Stella Chen, a scientist researching the fictional planet Gaia.

faq.question: Can I use it for roleplay sessions?
faq.answer: Yes. Its staged structure supports a short, calm roleplay or interactive-fiction session.

faq.question: What language is the source material?
faq.answer: The source is primarily Chinese and includes English scientific and narrative terms.

faq.question: Does it execute commands or access files?
faq.answer: No. The skill contains narrative text only. The detected backticks are Markdown code fences.
